text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day after the year-end wrap-up, Still in Love contacted me asking if she could borrow the Trainer's office.
choice_data_list: (I wondered what she was going to do, but—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year.
Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Called in by Still in Love,
I arrived at the Trainer's Room to find...
the room decorated for the New Year.
choice_data_list: Did you make this decoration...?
Did you make this decoration...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah... y-yes.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "Well, um... you've always taken such good care of me, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I wanted you to enjoy a festive New Year's mood
and take some time to relax...
choice_data_list: Still...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Was I... being a bother...?
choice_data_list: No! I'm really happy, thank you!
No, really! I'm so happy, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Um, besides the decorations,
I also prepared a few other things.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Which one will you choose—
choice_data_list: Of course, I'm going to enjoy every bit of it.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes.
In that case... what should we start with?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For now, if I were to choose from
the three Still in Love suggested—
choice_data_list: Read a book recommended by Still.
Eat Still's handmade osechi
Play with Still's handmade otedama

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to take it easy this New Year's.
Reading a book should help relax my mind and body.
Besides—
choice_data_list: I'm really curious about your recommendation.
I'm really curious about your recommendation.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
!
...Fufu, in that case...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I brought a few with me...
I really love historical novels, you see...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Among our new arrivals,
how about this one?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: It's the story of a princess who harbored a secret during a certain era in Japanese history.
choice_data_list: I see... Is the story good?
I see... Is the story good?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
There's that too, but...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I haven't read it yet.
I wanted to read it... together with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sitting side by side with Still in Love, reading our books at our own paces...
We spent a peaceful time together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To my surprise, she apparently made the osechi all by herself.
Seeing how much effort she put in made me want to eat it right away.
choice_data_list: I'm really looking forward to it!
I'm really looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... B-But... please don't get
your hopes up too high.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Well, osechi-style, I suppose.
It's just home-cooked food packed together, really...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: The portion isn't that large either. Here, please...
choice_data_list: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the bento box she gave me...
Inside, small portions of traditional Japanese dishes like chikuzenni and tamagoyaki were neatly packed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Crafted into bite-sized pieces that show Still in Love's delicate kindness... Just looking at them brings a natural smile to my face.
choice_data_list: It really puts the mind at ease...
It really puts your heart at ease, doesn't it...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I did plenty of taste tests, so please go ahead and enjoy...♪

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah... Beanbag juggling...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even she seemed surprised by the result...
but there was one thing that wouldn't stop bugging me.
choice_data_list: Handmade...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I looked into it, and it seemed easy enough to make.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Um, I was just trying to come up with enough New Year's-themed things to fill out the numbers, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The handmade beanbags she timidly handed over...
were made with ribbons, lace, and other adorable patterns—
choice_data_list: That's so like you, Still. Cute.
That's so like you, Still — so cute!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: Could you give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Hu- Ah... Uh, yes, sir...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Um... throw it upward and—kyaa!
...Then, a little lower—aaah!
...Uu... H-How embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dropping it on her head,
sending it flying far away...
Still in Love was looking a bit clumsy.
